Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal static state by creating a buffer which stores an external array into a static field (EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
a static field.
 If unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The static field 'sensitiveData' stores a reference to an external array. This exposes the internal static state, as modifications to the array through any reference will affect the static field's data.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls ExposeStaticState.showBug with an external array, which is then modified via the returned array. This exposes the static state, as changes to the returned array reflect in the static field sensitiveData.
